newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico interest rates seen falling to about 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico interest rates seen falling to about 20 pct.

text.p: Mexico's Cetes, or treasury bill, rates are seen falling to about 20 percent toward the end of April or in the first part of May, Mexican bank Ixe said in a report released on Sunday.

"Our scenerio is that rates will be about 20 percent towards the last week of April or the first part of May, due to the decline in inflation as well as the constant flow of foreign funds into Mexico looking for the attractive returns," the bank said in a report.
The benchmark 28-day Cetes rate rose 28 basis points to 22.61 percent at Banco de Mexico's primary Cetes auction last week.
